parsed.explanation: Combined regime is tier-1 universal exposure: binary passport/federal-facility rules, entry screening for document discrepancy with possible permanent fraud ineligibility, and a congressionally attached facilities ban in this non-repealable seat. Documented immigration-custody forced labour, beatings and sexual abuse, and prison hormone removal raise severity if detained. No execution or routine imprisonment for presentation, and courts, injunctions, hate-crime law and legal aid provide partial recourse, keeping it above 0.35 anchors but below 0.55 administrative-only cases.

entry_documents.exposure: Passport X and mismatched markers stopped; existing X valid to expiry. Feb 2025 cable: document discrepancy casting doubt on sex -> refuse case, seek evidence; suspected wilful misrepresentation -> consider permanent lifetime fraud ineligibility. Passports confiscated/blocked reported, some stranded.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports remain valid; lawsuits challenging marker policy; several executive orders blocked/enjoined; foreign governments issued advisories.
entry_documents.interaction: Document discrepancy at entry can escalate to refusal, then fraud/ineligibility inquiry, then detention/custody exposures.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Immigration custody: transgender men reported forced labour, beatings, solitary, severe sexual abuse. National prisons from 2026: hair cutting, hormone removal, psychiatric substitution; care denial reported.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Courts and civil-liberties litigation exist; some orders enjoined. No documented visitor-specific custodial protocol.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry fraud allegation or facilities trespass can lead to detention where birth-sex placement and reported abuse risks apply.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal order bars government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity. This seat has no local ban but a national-legislature-attached ban, scope unspecified; Dec 2024 protest arrests at legislature building.
federal_state_facilities.protection: 29 states plus capital district mapped as no ban in categories; seat placed on July 2026 low-risk list, but assessment cautions override by national legislature/executive.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Local low-risk placement does not override federal facilities, federal entry, or congressional ban; traveller encounters combined regime.

care_services.exposure: Executive orders target gender-affirming care for minors; care banned in 27 states; Oct 2025 proposed rule would bar public insurance reimbursement under 18; DOJ hospital subpoenas documented for residents.
care_services.protection: Several orders blocked/enjoined; proposed health rules unresolved. No documented visitor care-continuity protection.
care_services.interaction: Adult care interruption via hormone removal in custody documented; minor traveller faces heightened care and school-related enforcement climate.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Federal framing as binary at birth, removal of gender-ideology materials, investigation/prosecution directives re schools, DOJ reward memo using 'radical gender ideology', May 2026 strategy prioritising 'radically pro-transgender' groups.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity; 2020 employment ruling; courts enjoining some orders; counterterrorism text states not for mere disagreement.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: State threat-framing supports facilities, document and custody exposures; litigation is the main counterweight.

minors_guardians.exposure: Jan 2025 orders: care for minors as 'mutilation', law-enforcement investigation of schools, criminal prosecution of teachers facilitating social transition including names/pronouns; school funding threats.
minors_guardians.protection: Several orders blocked/enjoined; marriage and employment protections do not address minor care/school exposure. Not documented. for visitor-specific guardian protections.
minors_guardians.interaction: Travelling guardian/minor: minor's care, school enrolment and disclosure risks interact with federal/state bans and document rules.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No jurisdiction-specific police practice, hate-crime enforcement, or street violence documented. Nationally solicited poll: 66% support assigned-sex document laws. Airport screening can be invasive and outing.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime law; only 23 states cover gender identity in bias statutes, 37 lacked as of 2019. Local enforcement not documented.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police encounter at facilities/border is documented pathway; street-level response for visitors is unknown, not assessed as safe.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Remedies are slow, contested and uneven; passport and executive-order litigation unresolved; seat's protections can be overridden without local change; bathroom-ban scope, buildings, enforcement beyond 2024 arrests not specified.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Civil-liberties suit, injunctions, legal-aid FAQ, low-risk listing; corrections bureau stopped reporting trans prisoner numbers from 2025, reducing transparency.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Partial judicial recourse mitigates but does not cancel universal document/facility exposure or custody harm.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar universal exclusion without execution/imprisonment as central harm, and weak remedy. Higher than 0.35 because courts enjoin orders, hate-crime law exists, and custody abuse is not routine for mere entry; lower than 0.55 because entry fraud can mean lifetime ineligibility.

Similar secondary screening, delay and discretionary refusal. Lower than 0.55: screening here is tied to binary sex determination and possible permanent fraud finding, plus documented severe immigration-custody abuse, not only administrative delay.

Higher than 0.75 anchors where brief detention ends in release with counsel/compensation. This case has congressionally attached facilities ban, federal facility exclusion, and documented custody sexual abuse/forced labour, so materially below 0.75.

parsed.synthesis: Interaction dominates: foreign document -> entry discrepancy -> refusal/fraud inquiry -> possible detention with birth-sex custody and reported abuse; facilities use -> trespass arrest precedent. Local seat protections are fragile, non-repealable and subject to direct national override, so low-risk listing does not neutralise federal regime. Courts, injunctions and advocacy provide real but incomplete recourse. For a minor, care/school federal targeting adds exposure. Net: elevated risk, below administrative-only 0.55 cases.
